text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

words.gloss_range: commanded saying; commissioned declaration rather than private opinion or free narration
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, report, stance, and utterance; the local imperative selects authorized public declaration
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) frames the whole following sequence as commissioned speech: the response is not a negotiated rebuttal but an instructed utterance whose payload begins immediately with gathering. Its clipped imperative form carries an implicit second-person singular addressee and makes the speech act sharp, while the q-w-l field still lets the reader feel inner content crossing into public declaration. In the surrounding command chain (34:24-25), this occurrence moves from challenge and disclaimer into the announcement of divine procedure.

topics.headline: commissioned speech carries the judgment sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole ayah is delivered as authorized speech, not as a detached theological comment.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the following utterance the quoted complement of {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), so the CRITICAL claim that it frames the whole answer is locally supported.

topics.headline: clipped imperative and implicit addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar of commission: a short command with an unspoken addressee launches the response.
topics.reason: QAC marks a second masculine singular imperative, and the implicit-subject evidence supports the form-specific reading.

topics.headline: speech as public release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word turns hidden verdict content into public, authorized utterance while keeping the verdict's source beyond the speaker.
topics.reason: The mouth-threshold image is useful as lexical coloring, but local grammar narrows it to commanded public declaration rather than general speech theory.

topics.headline: surah-local command chain reaches verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated command formula in 34:24-25 now advances from polemical exchange to divine adjudication.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah references, and the local opening command coherently continues that sequence.

words.gloss_range: will gather or bring together; locally a future divine assembly of the contested relation
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, assembling, bringing dispersed things into one field; local grammar selects assembly before judgment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the shared Lord named as the delayed subject
the shared between-space governed by the gathering verb
the sequencing hinge before the opening verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}) opens the quoted content with a future-facing divine act: the subject is delayed until {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}), so agency emerges after the divided interval has already been named. The j-m-ʿ image gathers scattered sides into one accountable field, and the absence of a direct object with {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) keeps the relation itself in view. Before {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}), this is stage one of the procedure: the forum is formed before the verdict is opened. That divine gathering reverses created beings gathering to attempt speech (17:88) and anticipates the wider same-surah gathering at 34:40, while the nasal texture of the verb leans audibly into the following shared interval.

topics.headline: delayed subject makes divine agency emerge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gathering is not self-assembly or partisan victory; the shared Lord appears as the external gatherer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) as subject of {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}), supporting the agency claim.

topics.headline: scattered dispute becomes one forum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the image of divided parties being drawn into one accountable field rather than merely being mentioned together.
topics.reason: The verb has no direct object and takes {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) as relational complement, so the forum reading is locally licensed.

topics.headline: future imperfect sets stage one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is pending and ordered: assembly precedes opening rather than collapsing into instant retaliation.
topics.reason: The imperfect form and the later {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) support a future procedural stage.

topics.headline: human gathering reversed into divine procedure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that created beings gathering to attempt speech (17:88) contrasts with God gathering disputants for judgment, while the same-surah echo in 34:40 widens the exposure.
topics.reason: The referenced echoes are concrete and do not override the local parse; they sharpen the direction of agency.

topics.headline: sound binds gathering to the interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recited sound of the gathering verb leans into the following shared interval.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but concrete and aligns with the adjacent verb-complement relation.

words.gloss_range: between us; a shared relational interval functioning adverbially under gathering
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, relation, distinction, and clarification; locally the shared gap becomes a gatherable forum

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the gathering verb that governs this first interval
the shared Lord whose suffix sound echoes the interval

words.prose: The first {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) makes the object of concern a shared interval, not only a list of persons. Its -nā suffix places both sides inside one grammar of exposure, and its adverbial role under {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}) turns separation into a forum. Because b-y-n can hold distance and clarification together, the word prepares the later opening: what is between the parties is already the space where evidence can become distinct, with echoes such as verification in 49:6 and distance language in 34:19 kept as supporting contrasts. The repeated nasal suffix also audibly ties this shared interval to {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}), the shared Lord who will address it.

topics.headline: shared interval under gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gathering operates on the relation between the parties, and the suffix keeps both sides inside it.
topics.reason: The attachment marks this word as the adverbial complement of {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}), and the suffix evidence supports the shared discourse-role reading.

topics.headline: distance already awaits clarification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the between-space is not inert distance; it is the place where contested claims can become clear.
topics.reason: The clarity branch is lexically relevant, but under the first governor it remains preparatory; the second {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) carries the stronger disclosure role.

topics.headline: first half of repeated between-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same interval will be gathered first and opened later, while 34:19 helps show distance language being turned into adjudication.
topics.reason: The exact repetition at word 7 and the concrete same-surah reference make the structural payoff visible.

topics.headline: suffix sound ties interval to Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible tie between the parties' shared interval and their shared Lord.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is modest but anchored in the repeated -nā sequence.

words.gloss_range: our Lord; shared divine subject of the gathering and carried-forward subject of the opening
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, sustaining care, and bringing to completion; locally shared Lordship grounds adjudication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second verb that inherits the same subject

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) names the actor only after the act and the contested interval have appeared, so divine agency arrives as the answer to separation. The possessive -nā makes the Lord grammatically shared, undercutting any claim that one side alone owns the forum. The r-b-b range of mastery, sustaining care, and completion fits the two-stage movement: the one who gathers also carries the subject forward into {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}). Universal Lordship (1:2) and same-surah echoes such as 34:23 converge here into a shared judge, and the repeated -nā refrain binds contested relation, Lordship, and judgment exposure.

topics.headline: one shared Lord spans both acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both gathering and opening belong to one shared Lord, not to competing party jurisdictions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) the subject of the first verb and strongly licenses it as subject of the second.

topics.headline: mastery and care ground adjudication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment is grounded in Lordship as encompassing authority and sustaining care, not in bare force.
topics.reason: The broader r-b-b range survives, but local syntax narrows it to the divine title acting as subject in this dispute.

topics.headline: title not episodic seizure of control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action flows from an established divine relation rather than from a newly asserted act of dominance.
topics.reason: The nominal title and subject function support the stable-relation payoff.

topics.headline: same-surah and universal lordship echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal Lordship (1:2) and the earlier question about Lordship in 34:23 converge here into a shared judge over disputants.
topics.reason: The cited references are concrete and support contrast without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: possessive refrain binds relation and Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated -nā binding contested relation, Lordship, and judgment exposure across the clause.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix is morphologically present and discourse-relevant.

words.gloss_range: then; sequence with delay, spacing, and possible rank progression

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first imperfect verb before the hinge
the second imperfect verb after the hinge

words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) is the hinge between two complete divine acts. It places opening after gathering with procedural distance and rank, so judgment is not a reflex strike but the next ordered stage once a common field exists. Its standalone particle shape and heavy pause keep {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}) and {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) related without merging them.

topics.headline: sequence turns judgment into procedure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gathering and opening are staged as two ordered acts, with a real interval between forum and verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment marks {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) as coordinated after {{ar:يَجْمَعُ}} ({{tr:yajmaʿu}}), and the particle itself supplies the staged relation.

topics.headline: not immediate fa-like consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is both later in sequence and weightier in rank, not merely an immediate consequence marker.
topics.reason: The local contrast with simple coordination supports retaining both delay and escalation without overreading chronology.

topics.headline: particle makes the hinge audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recitational slowing between the two imperfect verbs.
topics.reason: The form and sound observation aligns with the syntactic hinge.

words.gloss_range: will open, decide, or judge; locally judicial opening between parties by truth
words.root_gloss_range: opening, unlocking, granting access, victory, and judicial decision; local complements select judgment-opening, not conquest or mere access

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the between-space governed by the opening verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) is the second divine operation on the same relational domain. With no direct object, with {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}), and with {{ar:بِٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:bi-l-ḥaqqi}}), the verb keeps the physical image of opening a closed matter while the grammar selects adjudication by truth. The subject remains {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}), so no party commands the opening. The later title {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}) turns this future act into an attribute-grounded promise, and the shared f-t-ḥ sound makes that act-title thread audible. In contrast with human seeking of opening in 8:19, the decisive opening here belongs to God and is governed by truth.

topics.headline: opening selected as judgment by complements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not a generic opening: its complements make it the judicial disclosure of the dispute.
topics.reason: The local frame has no direct object and includes both the between-space and the truth-standard, selecting judicial opening.

topics.headline: closed matter opened into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete image of a barred dispute being opened into a readable verdict.
topics.reason: The physical opening image survives as metaphorical pressure, while local complements prevent a literal door or conquest reading.

topics.headline: same Lord opens without party control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no litigant commands or seeks the opening; the shared Lord performs it.
topics.reason: The inherited subject and declarative imperfect support the party-control contrast.

topics.headline: future act anticipates the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second stage is later explained by the matching title {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}).
topics.reason: The same root recurs as verb and title, making the echo local and structurally important.

topics.headline: human sought opening contrasted with divine opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human seeking of opening or victory (8:19) is displaced here by God's truth-governed opening.
topics.reason: The concrete reference sharpens agency without altering the local judicial frame.

topics.headline: opening root is heard across act and title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the f-t-ḥ sound thread across the verdict verb and the final title.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is anchored in an exact root recurrence.

words.gloss_range: between us; the same shared interval now governed by judicial opening
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, relation, distinction, and clarification; locally disclosure becomes dominant under the opening verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the opening verb governing this second interval

words.prose: The second {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) repeats the same shared interval, but under {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) it becomes more explicitly forensic. Both sides remain inside the verdict-space through the -nā suffix, while the b-y-n clarity branch becomes dominant: the gap is opened so right and wrong can be distinguished, as the echo to 2:256 helps sharpen. The repetition is therefore process, not redundancy: what God gathered is exactly what He opens. Recitationally, the -nā ending releases straight into the following truth-standard, so the shared interval is heard moving into its measure.

topics.headline: same interval becomes verdict-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same between-space changing role from gathered forum to opened verdict-space.
topics.reason: The exact phrase repeats while its governing verb changes, supporting the role-shift payoff.

topics.headline: both sides remain inside judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is not narrated over a distant other; the shared suffix keeps both disputing sides in the opened field.
topics.reason: The suffix is surface-form evidence and the referent profile warns against resolving it away.

topics.headline: between becomes evidence-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opened interval becomes a space where the contested matter is made distinct, with 2:256 as a sharpening echo.
topics.reason: Under the opening verb, the clarity branch is stronger than in the first occurrence and is not contradicted by reference evidence.

topics.headline: repetition encodes two-stage process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exact repetition maps one relational interval through gathering and then opening.
topics.reason: The repetition, changed governor, and sequencing particle jointly support the procedural map.

topics.headline: sound moves from interval to standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recited movement from the shared interval into the truth-standard.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is anchored in the immediate sequence from {{ar:بَيْنَنَا}} ({{tr:baynanā}}) to {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}).

words.gloss_range: by, with, according to; locally the preposition binding truth as means, manner, and standard

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the truth noun governed by this preposition
the opening verb whose standard is supplied by this phrase
the following nominal-clause pivot into the title seal

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small grammatical link that makes truth operational. Attached to {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}), it governs the noun as means, manner, and criterion for {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}), preventing the f-t-ḥ action from sounding like arbitrary access or force. Because it stands just before {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}), the phrase also bridges the verbal judgment to the final attribute seal.

topics.headline: preposition makes truth the criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth is not a slogan after the verdict; grammar makes it the governing standard of the opening.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) as governed by the preposition and as the standard for the verb.

topics.headline: bāʾ narrows broad opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad opening root is channeled into adjudication measured by truth.
topics.reason: The verb instance lists {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) as the relevant preposition and notes the judicial use.

topics.headline: attached phrase bridges to the titles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition is fused to the truth noun and placed as the hinge before the final divine attributes.
topics.reason: The orthographic and syntactic placement supports the bridge from action to attribute seal.

words.gloss_range: the truth, reality, right, due standard; locally definite criterion of judgment
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, rightness, due claim, established fact, and fixity; locally truth functions as the governed standard for opening

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing the truth noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) is not merely the topic of the judgment; through {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) it is the standard by which the opening happens. Its definiteness presents truth/right as a known, non-negotiable criterion rather than one party's claim to entitlement, and the fixed-reality image makes that standard feel hard rather than reshapeable by partisan speech. The ḥ-q-q field fuses reality and due right, so the verdict both discloses what is real and assigns what is owed. Same-surah movement from truth as spoken answer in 34:23 to truth as judicial instrument in 34:26 makes the phrase a hinge before the titles. In contrast with truth simply arriving in 17:81, here truth measures and opens the relation between parties.

topics.headline: definite truth becomes operational standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth is grammatically installed as the criterion of opening, not left as a negotiable abstraction.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and attached to the judgment verb as standard.

topics.headline: truth fuses reality and due right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is factual and juridical at once: it reveals reality and gives each claim its due.
topics.reason: The ḥ-q-q sense range supports truth and rightness together, and local judicial syntax makes both relevant.

topics.headline: fixed reality resists partisan smoothing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hardness of an established standard that party speech cannot reshape.
topics.reason: The fixed-reality image survives as lexical pressure, while the local phrase keeps the primary role as criterion.

topics.headline: truth moves from answer to instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah shift: truth is spoken in 34:23 and becomes the means of opening in 34:26.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete same-surah provenance and align with the local prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: truth bridges procedure and attribute seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final titles explain why opening by truth is possible.
topics.reason: The truth phrase closes the verbal beat immediately before the attribute seal.

topics.headline: truth operates in the between-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth does not merely arrive as a proposition, as in 17:81; here it measures and opens the relation between parties.
topics.reason: The concrete echo is valid as contrast and the local syntax makes truth relationally operative.

words.gloss_range: and, while, and he; locally a resumptive/circumstantial link into a nominal identity clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier sequencing particle contrasted with this conjunction
the fused conjunction-pronoun pivot into the nominal clause

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not add a third timed step after {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}). It resumes after the completed judgment phrase and attaches the final nominal clause to the preceding acts, so the ayah moves from what the Lord will do to who He is. Its fusion in {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) keeps the identity seal connected rather than floating as a detached maxim, while the open cadence gives a softer reset before the definite titles.

topics.headline: wa links action to identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause explains the acts instead of continuing the time sequence.
topics.reason: The final clause is nominal and follows a complete verbal judgment phrase, supporting a resumptive explanatory link.

topics.headline: different conjunction prevents third step reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between staged process and timeless grounding.
topics.reason: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) coordinates the two acts, while {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the nominal clause.

topics.headline: wa-huwa creates connected reset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a soft reset into the attribute seal while the conjunction still binds it to the verdict.
topics.reason: The written fusion and sound observation align with the clause pivot.

words.gloss_range: he; independent pronoun re-anchoring the predicates to the same divine actor

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the antecedent resumed by the pronoun
the preceding truth-standard from which the titles are kept distinct
the first title after the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the final clause its own explicit subject and points back to {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}). That prevents the titles from attaching to {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) or drifting as loose epithets; they predicate the same Lord who gathered and opened. The independent pronoun also marks the move from future acts to stable identity, so the verdict rests on who the actor is. Its short vocalic buffer makes the transition into {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}) audible rather than abrupt.

topics.headline: pronoun anchors titles to the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two titles belong to the same actor who gathered and opened.
topics.reason: The pronoun antecedent is strongly licensed as {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}), and the predicates attach to the pronoun.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun focuses identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar foregrounds this very actor as the ground of opening and knowledge.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is not required for suffixal reference and creates an identity pivot before the titles.

topics.headline: titles do not appose truth-standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final titles explain the Lord, not the truth-standard itself.
topics.reason: The sequence {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) starts a nominal clause after the prepositional phrase, blocking apposition to {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}).

topics.headline: from future acts to stable identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah leaving bilateral dispute for divine identity-grounded explanation.
topics.reason: The clause type changes from future verbal acts to a nominal identity clause.

topics.headline: pronoun audibly resets before title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a brief cadence buffer before the first title.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the immediate transition into {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}).

words.gloss_range: the decisive opener/judge; definite intensive title grounding the preceding act of opening
words.root_gloss_range: opening, unlocking, access, victory, and judicial decision; locally the title concentrates decisive opening and judging as a stable divine attribute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the pronoun whose predicate this title is

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}) is the first predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), not an apposition to truth. It returns to the root of {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) and turns the promised act into a named attribute: the Lord opens the closed dispute because He is the decisive opener-judge. The definite faʿʿāl pattern makes opening characteristic and intensified, while the variant {{ar:ٱلْفَاتِحُ}} ({{tr:al-fātiḥu}}) shows the same root could be presented with less attribute intensity. The doubled consonant makes that intensive pattern audible, and the rarity of the title-form gives special weight to the verse's climax. Human seeking of opening in 8:19 and 14:15 is thereby contrasted with God's reserved decisive opening.

topics.headline: first predicate names the actor's identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that decisive opening is predicated of the Lord as identity, not appended to the truth-standard.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the title the predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) and pairs it with the following title.

topics.headline: opening and judging converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title gathers access-opening and judicial deciding into one capacity over closed disputes.
topics.reason: The prior judicial verb and truth-standard select judge/opener, not conquest-only fatḥ.

topics.headline: faʿʿāl intensifies stable opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surface title presents opening as an enduring, intensified attribute, while the variant {{ar:ٱلْفَاتِحُ}} ({{tr:al-fātiḥu}}) exposes the markedness of that choice.
topics.reason: The variant preserves root and agency but changes pattern intensity, so it is valid contrast rather than a replacement of the local surface.

topics.headline: act returns as attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the internal echo: {{ar:يَفْتَحُ}} ({{tr:yaftaḥu}}) becomes {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}), so the act manifests the title.
topics.reason: The same root appears first as future verb and then as definite title in the final seal.

topics.headline: decisive opening reserved to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human attempts to seek opening or victory (8:19; 14:15) cannot turn fatḥ into claimant strategy, because the title reserves decisive opening to the knowing judge.
topics.reason: The recurrence contrast is concrete and the local pairing with knowledge constrains it away from partisan victory.

topics.headline: rare intensive title carries sound pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a marked, intensive title-form gives special weight to the verse's climax.
topics.reason: The title-form is marked in the supplied distribution and the doubled consonant supports the audible intensification claim.

words.gloss_range: the knowing, all-knowing; final definite title grounding judgment in complete knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, recognition, marks, and enduring awareness; locally comprehensive knowledge warrants truth-based judgment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired opening title before the knowledge title

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿalīmu}}) completes the title pair and makes knowledge the ayah's final pressure. It is not decorative: paired with {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}), it says that decisive opening is fully informed. The faʿīl form presents enduring comprehensive knowledge, and the root's mark/recognition field fits judgment that can distinguish hidden claims. Echoes from 34:3 and 58:7 widen this final title: knowledge of the unseen and secret councils becomes the epistemic warrant for judging disputed speech. The paired definite title cadence and final īm landing make the move from horizontal dispute to divine judgment audible at the close.

topics.headline: second title completes the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge stands as an independent ground of the verdict alongside decisive opening.
topics.reason: The title agrees with and follows {{ar:ٱلْفَتَّاحُ}} ({{tr:al-fattāḥu}}), forming the paired seal.

topics.headline: opening is fully informed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decisive opener judges by truth because he fully knows what truth requires.
topics.reason: The title pair follows the truth-standard, so knowledge directly warrants the preceding judgment.

topics.headline: faʿīl presents enduring knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is presented as a stable quality, not a momentary act of knowing.
topics.reason: The faʿīl title sits inside a nominal clause, supporting stable attribute force.

topics.headline: knowledge recognizes hidden marks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden claims cannot evade the verdict because knowledge can recognize and discriminate them.
topics.reason: The mark image is useful lexical pressure, narrowed to the courtroom function of discriminating claims.

topics.headline: unseen and secret knowledge become verdict warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge of the unseen in 34:3 and secret councils in 58:7 is narrowed here into a warrant for judging disputed speech.
topics.reason: The echoes are concrete and illuminate the final title without replacing the local title sense.

topics.headline: knowledge is the final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not on conflict but on the epistemic authority that frames the whole verdict.
topics.reason: The final word position and the title pair make knowledge the closure of the ayah.

topics.headline: paired definite titles close audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paired title cadence lifting horizontal dispute into divine judgment.
topics.reason: The parallel title shape and final cadence support the closure payoff.

baseline_models.mechanism: Dispersed parties are assembled into one shared interval without losing their distinction; the repeated interval is then judicially opened, and stable reality rather than either party's claim governs the decision.

activation_trace.role: Joining what was dispersed supplies the assembly that makes a common hearing possible.
The middle or interval between plural sides becomes the twice-marked arena of encounter and decision.
Judicially resolving closure between disputants supplies the governing action and its agent-title.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion that controls the opening.
Complete cognitive disclosure grounds the judge's competence rather than adding a detached attribute.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord will bring the two sides together and judge fairly.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a hearing: separated sides become co-present but remain distinguishable, then the closed dispute is opened against fully known reality.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence moves from collection to aperture: opening what was shut makes the contested interval appear, while proof brings its truth out of concealment and knowledge secures the disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Collection creates the common field upon which disclosure can occur.
Appearance and clarification turn the repeated interspace into what becomes visible.
An aperture in what was closed supplies the material image for disclosure.
Establishing and displaying truth makes the aperture evidentiary rather than merely spatial.
Knowledge guarantees that what the opening reveals is not partial sight.

changed_reading.before: Opening between the sides is only an idiom for deciding their case.
changed_reading.after: The decision also has an event-shape: assembly is followed by an aperture through which the concealed structure of the dispute becomes demonstrable.

baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord as one who repairs and brings to completion gathers a damaged relation, reopens its blocked connection, and orders it by what is due; adjudication can therefore repair the between without erasing the parties.

activation_trace.role: Repair, cultivation, and completion supply a restorative agency for the Lord named in the sequence.
Rejoining dispersed elements supplies the first restorative operation.
The connection standing between sides makes the object of repair relational, not only locative.
Removing an immaterial blockage or distress supplies the reopening of the damaged connection.
Binding due and entitlement constrain repair by obligation rather than compromise.

changed_reading.before: The opening separates the correct party from the incorrect party.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, true adjudication also repairs the shared relation by reopening what should connect the parties while enforcing what is due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah itemizes entering and exiting, denies that even an atom's weight can be absent, and fixes the range in a writing that carries judgment. The focus title ٱلْعَلِيمُ therefore functions as evidentiary completeness for the truthful opening.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge anchors the focus judgment in complete apprehension.
Fixed reality is the standard to which the complete record answers.
Ingress into an interior supplies one direction of the tracked crossings.
Passage to the outside supplies the complementary direction, closing the audit over transitions.
Absence, distance, and escape are explicitly excluded from the knower's field.
Weight and measure make the record granular down to the smallest accountable unit.
Written fixation that entails judgment turns total knowledge into an inspectable and binding record.

structural_cues: 34:2 pairs ingress with egress, and 34:3 expands from no absence through smallest and largest to a manifest book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tracked crossings, excluded absence, exact weight, and binding fixation; I infer that these are the evidentiary substrate of the focus opening. A live alternative is that they establish only general cosmological omniscience.

changed_reading.before: The judge knows enough to decide correctly.
changed_reading.after: The opening is backed by a transition-complete, scale-complete record in which neither distance nor minuteness removes anything from judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A decisive decree, the collapse of a supporting body, and the ensuing clarification that hidden knowledge was absent provide a concrete disclosure sequence. The focus opening can similarly be an event that removes what sustained a false appearance.

activation_trace.role: Opening what was closed anchors the event of exposure in the focus.
Clarification supplies the focus-side result of the opening.
An effective death decree supplies the decisive event that begins the unmasking.
Noisy, disordered collapse removes the prop that had preserved the mistaken appearance.
What had been hidden becomes clear only after the collapse, supplying the causal disclosure pattern.
Concealment from sight defines the knowledge falsely attributed before the event exposed its absence.

structural_cues: In 34:14 the sequence is decree, fall, clarification, then explicit negation of knowledge of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a decree that causes collapse and belated clarification; I infer an analogous event-arrow from the focus opening to exposed claims. The live alternative is that 34:14 illustrates ignorance without specifying the mechanics of 34:26.

changed_reading.before: The opener announces which proposition is true.
changed_reading.after: The opener can make truth occur as unmasking: a decisive event removes the support of a false appearance, so concealed ignorance becomes publicly visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A safe, measured inter-settlement corridor is followed by a demand to make its intervals distant and then by total tearing apart. The focus reverses that chain: the Lord gathers what self-produced distance scattered and reopens the between by truth.

activation_trace.role: Joining the dispersed anchors the reversal in the focus action.
The relation connecting sides makes the repeated between a social-spatial structure.
A connection distributed between settlements supplies the intact relational corridor.
Deliberate measured ordering makes the corridor maintained infrastructure rather than empty distance.
The request to produce distance supplies the human reversal of designed adjacency.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the social result that the focus gathering reverses.

structural_cues: 34:18 repeats بَيْن around visible, measured, safe transit; 34:19 repeats the interval in a request for distance and ends with total fragmentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designed adjacency, requested distancing, and fragmentation; I infer that 34:26 answers this sequence by regathering and truthfully restructuring the between. A live alternative is a general resurrection scene with no special Saba reversal.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is a neutral transport of parties to judgment.
changed_reading.after: Gathering reverses a moral geography: self-chosen distance had torn a community into pieces, and truthful opening restores an accountable interspace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence states the mutually exclusive guidance/error alternatives without assigning them, refuses to transfer questioning or crime across sides, reserves opening for the Lord, and then demands evidence for attached partners. Apparent rhetorical parity is therefore procedural restraint, not uncertainty about truth.

activation_trace.role: The commanded utterance makes the focus verse one move in an ordered public exchange.
Divine adjudication is the reserved procedure that resolves the suspended alternatives.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies one pole of the deliberately unassigned alternative.
Deviation from the intended path supplies the opposed pole awaiting resolution.
Reciprocal questioning is explicitly negated, preventing either side from loading its account onto the other.
Crime or culpability supplies the liability held apart pending the divine hearing.
Attaching an affiliation to another supplies the precise relation challenged after judgment is reserved.
Claimed partnership supplies the attachment that must be shown rather than merely asserted.

structural_cues: 34:24-27 form four consecutive قُلْ-framed moves: balanced alternatives, separated accounts, deferred divine opening, and an evidentiary challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies balanced alternatives, non-transfer of liability, divine adjudication, and a demand to show attachments; I infer a deliberate hearing protocol. A live alternative is only polemical courtesy before a conventional judgment statement.

changed_reading.before: Either side may be right, and the verse hedges until a future verdict.
changed_reading.after: The speaker deliberately withholds self-verdict, keeps accounts non-transferable, and submits the disputed attachments to an omniscient procedure that alone opens by truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene stops differentiated parties before their Lord and makes speech return from one segment to another. It supplies a concrete realization of opening between them as a face-to-face hearing in which blame, influence, and agency are contested aloud.

activation_trace.role: A gathered human mixture anchors the hearing's assembled parties.
Judicial opening anchors the later confrontation as a hearing rather than a random quarrel.
Mutual speaking over a matter supplies the dialogical form of the opened dispute.
Two-sided standing or confrontation supplies the procedural posture before the Lord.
Returning answer and speech makes accusation circulate back across the assembled sides.
Parts and factions preserve internal social differentiation within the total assembly.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 sustain alternating speech between weakened and arrogant groups only after they are stopped before their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an arrested assembly, factional differentiation, and returned speech; I infer that this tableau instantiates the focus opening as an adversarial hearing. A live alternative is that it is a separate blame scene illustrating only the verdict's aftermath.

changed_reading.before: The all-knowing judge can decide without hearing the parties.
changed_reading.after: The opening includes compelled confrontation: differentiated parties return speech across the interval until concealed structures of influence and responsibility are exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denied partnership, permission-limited intercession, total mustering, and the loss of mutual benefit or harm make gathering a decoalitioning operation. The Lord assembles everyone but does not preserve the protective networks they imagined.

activation_trace.role: Gathering the dispersed anchors the total assembly whose internal alliances are tested.
Separation within the assembly allows claimed solidarities to be tested and severed.
Participation or shared possession supplies the coalition explicitly denied.
An advocate joining another supplies the protective attachment restricted by permission.
Driving a whole group toward one destination supplies the universal muster.
Wholeness without omission intensifies the focus gathering into an all-inclusive assembly.
Part-to-part relations are retained just long enough for their claimed efficacy to be denied.
Benefit supplies one expected function of the coalition that no part can then control.
Harm supplies the opposite social power that likewise disappears from mutual control.

structural_cues: 34:22-23 deny shared ownership and autonomous joining; 34:40-42 later muster everyone and deny part-to-part control of benefit or harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied partnership, restricted advocacy, total muster, and mutual powerlessness; I infer that the focus gathering dismantles imagined protection networks before truth opens. A live alternative is that these passages critique worship without defining the assembly's internal mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Two already-formed camps are gathered intact for a verdict.
changed_reading.after: The assembly first strips away imagined ownership, advocacy, and mutual power, so truth opens between exposed agents rather than protected blocs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near echo of Lord, truth, and intensive knowledge recasts truth as something projected into the contested field; its arrival leaves falsehood unable either to initiate or recur. Opening by truth can therefore be an active breach, not only a neutral comparison.

activation_trace.role: Opening a closure anchors the image of truth breaching a blocked field.
Establishing and displaying truth anchors the force as revelatory rather than arbitrary.
Casting or throwing at distance supplies the kinetic entry of truth into the dispute.
The projected object is truth that establishes and manifests what is real.
Intensive knowledge of hidden things supplies the source-control behind the projection.
Initiating an operation supplies the first capacity that falsehood loses.
Removal from effective reality supplies the disabled opponent of truth.
Return after cessation supplies the second capacity denied to falsehood, preventing recurrence.

structural_cues: 34:48 repeats قُلْ, رَبِّى, بِٱلْحَقِّ, and an intensive knowledge-title from the focus; 34:49 immediately narrates truth's arrival and falsehood's incapacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies projected truth followed by falsehood's loss of beginning and return; I infer a causal arrow from projection to breached closure. A live alternative is that the two ayat merely proclaim victory after a conventional verdict.

changed_reading.before: Truth is the static standard consulted by the judge.
changed_reading.after: Truth is also operative: the all-knowing Lord projects it into the closed dispute, where it opens the field and disables falsehood's production and recurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending contrasts unavoidable near seizure with impossible reaching from far, marks remote speech about the unseen, and finally installs a barrier in a repeated between-construction. The opener's act is selective and timed: truth becomes accessible for judgment while belated access to the desired reversal is closed.

activation_trace.role: Opening a closure anchors one side of the terminal access contrast.
The traversable or adjudicable interval anchors the relation whose accessibility changes.
Failure to escape or outrun reach supplies the unavoidable side of the gate.
Reaching by extension supplies the access now attempted too late.
Distance from nearness makes the attempted reach structurally impossible.
Casting speech or accusation supplies their earlier unsupported projection from afar.
What is hidden from sight identifies the inaccessible domain about which remote speech was thrown.
A barrier separating two things supplies the final closure complementary to the focus opening.
Repeated separation between them and what they desire makes the closing construction directly echo the focus interspace.

structural_cues: 34:51-53 repeat near/far reachability, and 34:54 closes the surah with حِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ, a negative counterpart to يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unavoidable capture, failed remote reach, speculative projection, and a final barrier; I infer coordinated opening and closing within one judicial timing. A live alternative is that the final barrier is punishment unrelated to the focus title.

changed_reading.before: The Opener simply removes every barrier so truth can be seen.
changed_reading.after: The Opener governs access: the interval is opened for timely truth and judgment, while the route to a belatedly desired reversal becomes irreversibly barred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, not a proposed lexical gloss for يَفْتَحُ. It remains anchored in gathering, the repeated interspace, and opening, while 34:10-11 supplies softened hardness, complete coverage, measured fit, and linked perforations. Downstream prose should mark it as an exploratory mechanism for calibrated relation.

activation_trace.role: Joining separate units anchors the analogy's movement toward a functional whole.
The interval between units anchors the space that must be proportioned rather than erased.
Aperture supplies the focus-side image for openings that permit articulation.
Softening what is hard supplies the first condition for refashioning rigid boundaries.
Iron-like resistant hardness supplies the boundary material that is transformed, not discarded.
Completion and full adequacy supply the protective whole produced by the fitted parts.
Conformity to proper measure supplies calibration of the openings and links.
Perforating and linking rings supplies the mechanism by which separate hardened units become articulated protection.

changed_reading.before: Truthful opening only cuts a line between right and wrong.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, truthful opening calibrates the spaces and links between distinct parties, transforming rigid separation into an articulated and protective order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pair-to-individual sequence is procedurally suggestive but does not explicitly identify itself with the final gathering. It remains anchored in يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا and the subsequent opening, while 34:46 supplies standing in twos and singly before reflection. Downstream prose should present it as a possible change of social scale, not as the fixed scene of judgment.

activation_trace.role: A gathered human mixture anchors the collective scale from which the procedure begins.
The interval between persons anchors the relational scale retained inside the assembly.
Opening an immaterial blockage anchors the possibility that altered grouping enables understanding.
Rising with resolve supplies deliberate standing outside passive crowd momentum.
Joining one to one supplies the smallest relational unit in which claims can be tested.
The solitary individual supplies the scale at which collective cover is removed.
The heart's repeated movement over a matter supplies the cognitive work enabled by the smaller scales.

changed_reading.before: Gathering maximizes the crowd before a single collective verdict.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, assembly may precede a controlled reduction from crowd to pair to individual, opening truth by removing collective cover while preserving relational examination.

strongest_changes: The all-knowing title became a claim of transition-complete and scale-complete evidence, not generic omniscience.
The Saba corridor turned gathering into a reversal of self-produced distance and fragmentation.
The immediate قُلْ sequence and the later returned-speech scene turned opening into a restrained but public hearing.
Denied partnership, total mustering, and the terminal barrier made the opening both decoalitioning and selectively timed.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly gave the focus interspace a mechanism: measured connection can be fragmented, parties can be stopped and made to return speech, truth can enter as an operative force, and an opening for judgment can coexist with a final closure against belated reach.
remaining_uncertainties: The restorative رَبّ plus بَيْن model is visibly branch-anchored but may exceed the ayah's primary juridical force.
The armor sequence should remain a contained material analogy unless further evidence makes calibrated apertures more than an outlier.
The final opening/barrier polarity may describe one coordinated judicial act or only a thematic counterpoint across the surah.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Judgment first gathers, then opens the closed dispute.** `ج م ع/B001` is gathering scattered parts into one whole, `ف ت ح/B003` settling a closed dispute by judgment, `ح ق ق/B004` contesting claims to right, and `ع ل م/B001` knowing as something becomes clear. Repeated `بيننا` holds the parties in relation across gathering and opening. Gathering assembles the full case; opening resolves its closure; truth supplies the criterion. The packet provides sequence; I infer that no just opening occurs before scattered claims are collected. The ayah reads adjudication as comprehensive assembly followed by disclosure, not a premature verdict.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:31-33 enacted the promised gathering of rival claims, while the unresolved blame-loop showed why an external opening by truth is required.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Gathering followed by adjudicative separation.** `ج م ع B001` supplies gathering scattered parts into one whole, `ب ي ن B001` separation and parting, `ف ت ح B003` settling a closed dispute by judgment, and `ح ق ق B005` making truth stand. The same `بَيْنَنَا` first lies inside gathering and then inside opening. The branches assign assembly the precondition and opening the discriminating act. The packet supplies the order with `ثُمَّ`; I infer that judgment sorts only after all parties are present. Divine opening reads as truth-based separation within a completed gathering.

2. **An opening that discloses what gathering contains.** `ف ت ح B008` supplies inner opening by disclosure. The names `ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ` join opening to knowledge, while 34:21 has treated trial as manifestation and 34:23 has treated permission as a gate. The branch gives opening an epistemic role. The packet supplies those gates and the divine names; I infer that adjudication exposes the interior basis of the split. Judgment reads as disclosure as well as verdict.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:31, at the forward edge of the window, concretized the promised gathering: parties are stopped together and their speech returns between them. That later scene made the opening a disclosure of contested responsibility, not only an abstract verdict.

baseline.text: De ki: ‘Rabbimiz bizi bir araya toplayacak, sonra aramızda gerçekle hüküm verecektir. O, hüküm veren ve bilendir.’

findings.text: Hüküm önce dağılmış tarafları ve iddiaları tek bir dosyada toplar, ancak bundan sonra kapalı anlaşmazlığı gerçekle açıp ayırır.
Açma eylemi yalnız karar vermekle kalmaz, ayrılığın içerideki nedenlerini görünür kılan bir açıklama işlevi de görür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Separated Accounts Converge in Relational Sorting
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Dialogue first keeps opposed positions and liabilities distinct, then gathers the parties so truth can sort valid relations from fabricated attachments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Rhetorical symmetry is temporary rather than relativizing: separated accounts preserve responsibility until adjudication can expose false affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Assembly Judges and Detaches
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dispersed parties are gathered, judgment opens between them in truth, and alleged partners are exposed as persons wrongly attached to an affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering the dispersed (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`), judicial opening (`quranic:root_001124:B003/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`), knowing disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`), wrongful affiliation attachment (`quranic:root_001347:B002/m01`), shared partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`), prevailing authority (`quranic:root_001008:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering does not erase difference; it supplies the setting in which relations can be adjudicated. The latent fostered-or-attached sense of `أَلْحَقْتُم` recasts partnership as a manufactured social placement.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخطاب اللفظي المسموع.

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol azlığı yoksulluk, düşüklük, az sayma ve kalıba bağlı yokluk değerlerine kadar genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel azlığı özellikle mal, yiyecek ve verili miktar örnekleri çevresinde toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmayışını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel azlık alanları büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak bu kolun değerlendirme, toplumsal sonuç ve kalıba bağlı olumsuzluk uzantıları komşu kartta aynı sınırla kurulmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolun çekirdeği sayı ve miktar azlığıdır; değersizlik bunun ikincil bir sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kolun çekirdeği güçsüzlük, aşağılık ve düşünme yetisindeki zayıflıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da azlıkla değersizlik veya düşüklük arasında anlam ilişkisi kurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda değersizlik azlığın uzantısıdır; komşu kolda ise zayıflık ve aşağılık bağımsız çekirdektir, bu yüzden olağan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol bir şeyin sayıca veya miktarca az oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ses benzerliği anlam birliği doğurmaz: biri çokluğun karşıtı olan azlığı, diğeri uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunan baş veya tepeyi adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel azlıkla en yakın örtüşme, değersizlikle kurulan yan ilişki ve aynı kökteki tepe anlamıyla olası karışma en açıklayıcı üç sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس علو الشيء ولا الجرة ولا الحمل ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol başla ilgili renk, büyüklük, yaralanma, sayım ve alışveriş kullanımlarına kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insanın veya başka bir şeyin başını ve en üst bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Baş ve üst bölüm çekirdekleri yakındır; bu kol tepe ve topuz biçimini öne çıkarırken komşu kol başı daha geniş varlık ve kullanım alanlarında işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol insan başını ve kılıç topuzunu da üst veya baş kavramına bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yüksekliği hörgüç, soy üstünlüğü ve toplumsal onur alanlarına genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir şeyin en yüksek, öne çıkan tepe bölümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol somut baş ve üst parça sınırında kalır; komşu kol fiziksel doruktan toplumsal yüceliğe uzanan daha geniş bir yükseklik alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından azlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu anlam uzamsal bir üst bölüm adıdır; komşu anlam ise çokluğun karşıtı olan nicelik durumudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel baş anlamı, doruk ve yükseklik alanı ve aynı kökteki azlık anlamıyla biçimsel karışma sınırı en yararlı karşılaştırmalar olarak seçildi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القلة بمعنى الصغر أو العدد القليل، وليس إناء القُلَّة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة قلة الجبل وهي القطعة تستدير في أعلاه وهي القنة (jamhara)؛ القلة أعلى الجبل؛ قلة كل شيء أعلاه؛ رأس الإنسان قلة (sihah)؛ قلة كل شيء رأسه؛ قلة الجبل أعلاه؛ قبيعة السيف قلته؛ سيف مقلل (tahdhib)؛ قلة الجبل شعفه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol kabın özellikle iri oluşunu ve iki kaplık ölçü değerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel bir küp veya saklama kabını büyüklük koşulu olmadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da küp biçimindeki büyükçe saklama kapları için kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda büyük kapasite kurucu bir özelliktir; komşu kartta kap türü öndedir ve aynı ölçü uzantısı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; büyük küp anlamına en yakın iki kap komşusu ile aynı kökteki tepe anlamından ayrım, sınırı göstermek için yeterli ve yinelenmeyen karşılaştırmalardır.
branches.what_is_ar: القُلَّة إناء كالجرة الكبيرة، ومنها قلال هجر والحباب العظام
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قلة العدد، وليس رأس الجبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanların toplanması nedeniyle adlandırılmış yerleri ve günleri açıkça destekler; çağrı ve başka özel yapılar yalnız ayrı söz birimlerinde bulunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların bir araya gelmesi nedeniyle adı veya işlevi belirlenen bir yer ya da gündür.

error_profile.preserves: Toplanma nedenini ve bunun yer ya da günle kurduğu bağı korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer ile insanların orada toplanması arasındaki bağı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanların bir araya geldiği kutsal yer veya günler için kullanılan ad

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Toplantı yerindeki konuşma, danışma ve orada bulunan topluluğu da kapsar.

branches.branch_image_ar: موضع أو يوم أو نداء يجمع الناس

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجماعة نفسها إذا لم يكن اللفظ زمنا أو موضعا أو نداء.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi parmaklar kapanınca oluşan sıkılmış avucu, onunla vurmayı ve avuç miktarını aynı somut biçim çevresinde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel sayısal çokluk değildir; sıkılmış avucun biçimi, vuruşu veya alabildiği miktarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sıkılmış avuç çekirdeği ile avuç dolusu miktar ve bu avuçla vurma kullanımları birbirinden açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Parmaklar içe kapanınca oluşan sıkılmış avuç ve bu avucun kavrayabildiği miktardır; aynı el biçimiyle vurma da buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Parmakların kapanmasıyla el sıkılmış bir avuç biçimi alır ve bu biçimle vurulabilir.
Sıkılmış avucun aldığı şey bir avuçluk miktar olarak ölçülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sıkılmış avucu temel alır; bu avuçla vurmayı ve avucun doldurduğu para ya da meyve miktarını aynı biçime bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: sıkılmış avuç veya bir avuçluk miktar
concept_gloss.applicability: Elin kapanmış biçimini, onunla vurmayı ve bu elin aldığı miktarı birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Kapalı avuç biçimini ve bu biçimden doğan ölçü değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Meyve, para veya benzeri bir şeyin avucun alacağı miktarı anlatırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Miktarın kapalı avucun kapasitesiyle belirlenmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sıkılmış avuç veya bu avuçla vurma

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal el biçimi ve ondan doğan ölçüdür; komşu dal ise o elle bir şeyi tutup alma eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; avucun biçimi ile avuçlayarak alma eylemi arasındaki ayrım okuyucu için en yararlı sınırdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جمع الكف، الضرب بجمع الكف، ملء الجمع، والقبضة أو جمعة التمر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki biçimi de kadınla erkek arasındaki cinsel birleşmenin dolaylı veya doğrudan anlatımı olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız cinsel birleşmeyi anlatır; insan topluluğu ya da gebelikle birlikte kalma anlamları bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın cinsel birleşme anlamını verir ve aynı ses dizisine bağlı topluluk anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

concept_map.definition: Kadınla erkek arasındaki cinsel birleşme veya bu birleşmeyi anlatan örtülü söyleyiştir.

facets.statement: Kadınla erkek arasında cinsel birleşme gerçekleşir ve söz bunu doğrudan ya da örtülü biçimde anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iki söz biçimini aynı cinsel birleşme anlamında buluşturur; bunlardan biri özellikle örtülü anlatım olarak nitelenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kadınla erkek arasındaki cinsel birleşmenin doğrudan veya örtülü biçimde anlatıldığı kullanımları karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsel birleşme olayını ve örtülü anlatıma elverişli oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin doğal ve açık bir Türkçe yüklemle verilmesi gereken cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki kişi arasındaki cinsel birleşme eylemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: cinsel birleşme için kullanılan örtülü söz

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek olay ve anlam sınırı aynıdır; ayrılık yalnız bu olayı adlandıran sözlerin görüntüsündedir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek kadınla ilgili ölüm veya el değmemişlik durumudur; hayvanın ilk gebeliği genel tanıma katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kadının gebeyken ölmesi ile birleşme yaşamamış olması ayrılır; dişi eşeğin ilk gebeliği yalnız kendi biriminde tutulur.

facets.statement: Kadın, çocuğu hâlâ karnındayken ölür.
Kadın ölünceye dek ya da kocasının yanında bulunduğu sırada cinsel birleşme yaşamamıştır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının doğum gerçekleşmeden, karnındaki çocukla birlikte öldüğü anlatımda kullanılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ellerin boyunla birlikte bağlanıp hareketin kısıtlandığı özel bağ aracını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ellerin boyna bağlanmasını ve aracın kısıtlama işlevini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek eksiksiz bütünlüktür; büyüyüp belirli giysileri giyme kullanımı bütün dala ait kurucu bir özellik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bütünlük çekirdeği korunur; beden, pekiştirme ve giysi çağıyla ilgili özel gerçekleşmeler ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Canlının bedeninden hiçbir parça eksilmemiştir ve varlık bütündür.
Kişi bedence derli toplu bir yapıya ulaşmış veya gelişimini tamamlamıştır.
Bir topluluğun üyeleri eksiksiz biçimde hep birlikte bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı eksiksiz bedeni, olgunlaşmış insan yapısını ve herkesin birlikte hazır bulunmasını aynı bütünlük düşüncesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedenin parçasız eksiksizliğini, gelişimin tamamlanmasını ve üyelerin tümünün birlikte bulunmasını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Eksik parça kalmaması ve bütünün tüm öğeleriyle bulunması çekirdeğini korur.
